posts.text:
"10 worst states" based on what?

CNBC had "inclusivity" as one of its criteria. 

The numbers tell a different story.

2025 Net Migration Winners (on CNBC's list):
 • Texas +67,299 • Tennessee +42,389 • Georgia +27,333 • Alabama +23,358

Biggest Losers (none on the list):
 1.  California −229,077 2.  New York −120,917 3.  Illinois −56,235

The American people disagree with @CNBC

posts.text:
An independent, credible polling organization should conduct a survey to measure where Florida voters currently stand.

Ideally, it would be conducted by an established pollster with a demonstrated record of methodological rigor and impartiality.

I can think of a few.

With 41 days remaining until the primary, updated polling would provide voters and observers with current data on the state of the race.

Voters are the customers.  

Not your favorite candidate or a friend.

Florida Voters!
